Corporate Events
services.desc: Meetings, conferences, holiday parties, and galas, hosted on the historic grounds of Suneagles Golf Club with full in-house catering. TillingHouse hosts corporate gatherings of every scale, each with a dedicated room, in-house culinary service, and a private tour to plan it. The Byron Nelson Room seats up to seventy-five under cathedral ceilings, with a private bar and golf-course views for offsites, board meetings, and leadership retreats. The Ballroom holds up to five hundred guests, with a fifty-two-foot marble bar and a garden terrace, built for fundraisers, award nights, and company-wide
